subject: Hosted trial footprint + proposed rate gating for quickstart
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@olivetech.com>, Ajay Kumar <ajay.kumar@finlytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Jul 2028 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted trial footprint + proposed rate gating for quickstart

Hi Sarah / Ajay —

Thanks again for the demo earlier — great conversation and really useful context on the realtime summarization use case. Below is a short recap and a proposed lightweight hosted quickstart so you can validate latency/quality before any Dedicated/VPC investment.

Recap (what you shared)
- Primary flow: user uploads transcript -> real-time chunking -> model generates per-chunk summary + short bullets -> final stitched summary.
- Expected pilot traffic: 200–400 end-users/day, peak bursts ~25–40 concurrent summarizations.
- Typical payload: ~3–5 requests/user/session, avg output ~180 tokens.
- Compliance note: all data should be retained for 30 days; EU residency not required for pilot.

Proposed Hosted quickstart (recommended path)
- Sandbox endpoints: 1 sandbox key for integration testing; 1 staging key for pre-production.
- Initial rate gating (hosted): 3 rps sustained per API key, burst to 10 rps for 20–30s windows. Concurrency cap per key: 20 simultaneous completions.
- Token budget: 100k output tokens/day for the sandbox key (we can scale nondisruptively).
- Fallbacks: automatic fallback to a smaller model variant when latency exceeds 2s / token or when provisioning limits hit.

Questions for you (quick)
1) Does the pilot need VPC/isolation on day 1, or is Hosted acceptable for the initial 4–6 week validation?
2) Confirm average tokens per response (we used 180 above) and expected requests/day (rough ballpark).
3) Any IP allowlist or egress restrictions we should prep for?

Next steps
- If Hosted is ok: we’ll provision sandbox keys, share the quickstart checklist (attached), and schedule a 45-min technical onboarding with Grace (SE).
- If you expect sustained QPS > 50 for production within 3 months, we should simultaneously scope Dedicated capacity.

Attachments: finlytics-hosted-quickstart-checklist.pdf (provisioning steps + sample cURL), proposed-rate-plan.csv (example throttle tiers).

I’m free Thu or Fri for the onboarding — propose Thu 7/5 11:00am PT.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt

> Hi Sarah / Ajay —
> 
> Thanks again for the demo earlier — great conversation and really useful context on the realtime summarization use case. Below is a short recap and a proposed lightweight hosted quickstart so you can validate latency/quality before any Dedicated/VPC investment.

Thanks Hannah — this looks good and aligned with our internal expectations. A few quick clarifications: 
- We are comfortable starting on Hosted for the initial 6-week pilot. VPC can be discussed if we move to GA.
- Average tokens per response are closer to 150 (we padded earlier). Peak expected bursts could hit 60 concurrent summarizations for a short marketing event (1–2 hours) — usually under 2% of total daily traffic.
- We do have a basic IP allowlist that our ops team will share; no special egress rules beyond that.

I looped in Ajay (CTO) — he may want to join the technical onboarding. Please cc Ajay on the provisioning email.

Two asks from our side: 
1) Can you confirm what monitoring/alerting we’ll see in the console for token spend vs. rate gating?
2) Can you provision a staging key with the burst profile you suggested so we can run a quick stress run next week?

Sarah
Sarah Lin
Head of Product, OliveTech (Finlytics pilot)
sarah.lin@olivetech.com

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@olivetech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Ajay Kumar <ajay.kumar@finlytics.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Jul 2028 07:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted trial footprint + proposed rate gating for quickstart

Thanks for the quick reply — great callout on the event burst (60 concurrent). Below is what Grace and I recommend given that profile and to keep the pilot low-friction.

Provisioning plan (we’ll execute once you confirm)
- Sandbox key (integration): 3 rps sustained, burst to 10 rps for 20–30s. Token cap 100k/day.
- Staging key (stress run): same as sandbox but temporarily increase burst to 60 rps for up to 5 minutes during the scheduled stress test. We’ll monitor and roll back if unrelated throttles trigger.
- Production gating guidance: if average sustained QPS > 25 for 24h OR > 50 concurrent completions for a week, we recommend scoping Dedicated capacity.

Observability / alerts
- Console: token-by-token cost view, per-route latency p50/p95, per-key 1-min request rate.
- Alerts we’ll wire: token burn > 80% of daily cap, sustained 5-min error rate > 1%, and latency p95 > 3s.
- We’ll share a customizable PagerDuty webhook and a Slack integration for the pilot.

Action items
- Sarah / Ajay: confirm the stress-test window (suggest Tue 7/10 09:00am PT) and share the IP allowlist.
- Ben: I’ve asked you to own scheduling the 45-min onboarding with Grace + our infra lead.
- Grace: can you prepare the staging key and a short runbook for the stress test? (attachment: proposed-rate-plan.csv)

Attachments: finlytics-hosted-quickstart-checklist.pdf, proposed-rate-plan.csv

If that sounds good I’ll provision the keys and send them in a separate secure email (we don’t send keys in-thread).

Thanks — Hannah
